role_in_chain: Heavy-duty gas turbines and grid equipment; the slot itself is the scarce asset
current_growth_anchor: Q2 2026 revenue $11.1B +22% (+12% organic); orders $24.2B +88% organic; backlog $176B; FY26 guide revenue $45.5-46.5B, FCF $11.5-12.5B
growth_basis: Unit path is disclosed, not guessed: gas turbine output goes 20 GW annualised in Q3 2026 to 24 GW in 2028 to 30 GW in 2030, which is roughly 10% a year in units. Price is rising because the product is sold out, and the services annuity compounds with every GW installed. Wind subtracts. Long run sits below the current 22% because units cannot grow faster than the factories.
key_uncertainty: 116 GW of gas is 53 GW firm backlog plus 63 GW slot reservation agreements. The reservations are the softer half and their conversion rate under a capex slowdown has never been observed.
